correctness.rationale: On a bounded chain, all basic operations select from their arguments and the two endpoints, and each selection is governed by comparisons. Thus the output rank of a term in the finite subchain generated by a tuple depends only on its ordered equality type with endpoints marked. The map to the product of such chains is a homomorphism with kernel the identities of the generating class, hence injective on the free algebra. For a>b we have a→b=b<1, so D(a,b)=1∖(a→b)=1; for a≤b the implication is 1 and D=0. On the Boolean endpoint pair negation by implication into 0 switches the two values. The meet of correct crisp comparisons and their negations recognizes exactly one type, including endpoint ties. Joining these disjoint indicators each met with a representative of the desired output realizes any profile; thus the product map is onto. To count the factors C_{r+2}, choose m interior variables, give each of the k−m remaining labels either endpoint, and partition the interior variables into r nonempty ordered blocks. This gives the stated binomial/Stirling sum, including r=0 when only endpoints occur. For k=1 and k=2 the multiplicities are (2,1) and (4,5,2), hence orders 12 and 62,208. All types occur in C_{k+2}, and the term detecting 0<x_1<⋯<x_k<1 is identically zero on smaller chains but not there. This checks sharpness within single finite-chain tests, not within arbitrary finite algebras or for branching duals.

evidence: On every generating chain Δ(x)=(1∖x)→0 is the projection onto truth value 1, and conversely x∖y=x∧(Δ(x→y)→0). Finite chains embed in the standard [0,1] Gödel–Delta chain, and every finite tuple there generates only its endpoint-marked finite subchain. Thus their equational varieties and free-algebra problems are term-equivalent.

value.rationale: The exact rank-by-rank product describes all term operations in this full chain signature, with arbitrary independent coordinates, a constructive readback to terms, and exact cardinalities. It turns qualitative local finiteness into an effective classification of the equational quotient, identifying precisely how endpoint marking and equality multiplicities affect it. This information is more useful than a test-chain upper bound or a bare product-of-simples theorem. The known finite-test idea and small computed examples are not counted as separate advances.
residual_risks: Value is the explicit profile and census for the specified full-signature chain variety; it does not extend to arbitrary branching bi-intuitionistic frames.
